title: MacroPulse Alert
message:
NFP Aug: +162k vs 53k forecast — massive 3x beat (unemp 4.1%, wages +3.1% YoY)
Fed Gov Waller (Sep 3): "Give disinflation a chance" — hike odds fell to 48%; back to 52% post-NFP
BTC +4.3% (24h) → $81,240 — largest ETF inflows in 9 months
Oil (WTI) +5.1% (24h) → $91.48 — Iran tensions sustaining energy bid
BTC Dominance +2.7% (24h) → 59.77% — reinforcing Bitcoin-first setup ahead of Sep 16 FOMC
